Guidance & outlook: Several of our developments and expansions are expected to become operational through 2027 and mid -2028, while our recently completed offices continue to move steadily towards higher occupancy and billing.

Based on the leasing achieved and the discussions currently underway, we have clear visibility and confidence for leased occupancy at Phoenix Asia Towers and One National Park in Chennai to also progress towards 90% by the end of FY27.

Taken together and combined with the leasing momentum in retail that Rashmi spoke about, this pipeline gives us clear visibility into the next phase of portfolio growth, taking our retail platform towards 18 million square feet by 2030, as well as adding complementary asset bases in and around or on top of the retail developments.
Growth & demand: 1 ,075 crores and operating EBITDA grew 14% to Rs.
Our core revenue, that is revenue from our annuity businesses, grew 17% year-on-year to Rs.
4 ,730 crores, representing a strong 32% year - on-year growth, while consumption excl. jewelry and electronics across the portfolio grew by 24%.
Margins & costs: 1,033 crores, while EBITDA increased 19% year-on-year to Rs.
594 crores, increasing by 17% year-on-year, while EBITDA stood at Rs.
75 crores, up 44% year-on-year, and EBITDA of Rs.42 crores, up 31% year-on-year.
